text:
That's why...!
I hate
going ashore!
Hey, Yard?
Yes. This appears
to be my fault.
Huh?
While fighting my pursuers,
I used the sword's power
just once.
In the end, I couldn't control it.
A similar storm
broke out then, too...
And they might have
been caught up in it?
Do you mean they
may have gotten caught
in that storm...?
Most likely...
Now, now, brother.
There's no use dwelling
on the past.
With the ship wrecked,
we've got to make a life
for ourselves here, don't we?
M-Mmm...
Can't think straight
on an empty stomach.
Let's start there.
You're right...
Then let's go get some food,
same as always!
Aye, Captain!
Stealing from that monster
village again, are we?
We could just
catch some fish...
Bah! Plundering is
the true pirate's way!
Besides, I
hate fish!
Sheesh. What's there
to be proud of in that,
huh, Jakini?
Whoa! It's you!
That blasted Kyle!?
What are you lot
doing here???
It's a long story... More to the point,
stop acting like
a bunch of petty thieves.
Aren't you ashamed
to call yourselves pirates?
M-Mind your
own business!
WE CANNOT...
Your plundering
is causing us trouble.
That's enough
of your selfish excuses.
That's a problem
for us, you know.
I've got it...!
You're in league with
those monsters there...
You're planning to
make us suffer,
aren't you!? Aren't you!?
That's not it!
We want to settle this
by talking...
That's not true.
We want to reach
a peaceful agreement...
If that's how it is,
this means war!
Get 'em, lads!
Attack!
Aye, Captain!
I'm telling you to listen
